name: Humminbird PiranhaMAX 4 Sonar Fish Finder
description: Fishing blind is a thing of the past when you have a Humminbird PiranhaMAX 4 Sonar Fish Finder. Compact yet powerful, it incorporates many of the stylish features, functionality and quality of other Humminbird models but is priced for the budget-conscious fisherman. The easy operation and readouts make getting started with a fishfinder a less daunting task. The DualBeam Sonar uses 200/455 kHz frequencies over narrow and wide beams to indicate where the fish are at down to depths of 600' while the X-Press menu functions let you choose options for on-screen views. DualBeam Sonar works to depths of 600' and is optimized to show the greatest bottom contour definition, yet still indicate fish Sonar returns are clearly displayed on a 4.3 inch diagonal display with 256 color readout Tilt and swivel mount quickly adjusts the viewing angle to provide a clear view in all light conditions X-Press menu options to let you easily adjust view, depth range, chart speed and sensitivity Fish ID+ shows the intensity of a sonar return with 3 different icons to provide an indicator of relative fish size Order today! Gender: unisex. Age Group: adult.
